documents.title: Two-guide methodology
documents.body: Use RPG Site as the chronological 100% completion backbone and Game8 as the optimization layer. Keep every claim attributed. Verify disagreements with official or direct in-game evidence. Never silently blend subjective best-build advice into canonical facts.

documents.title: Alltrades Abbey power spike
documents.body: Alltrades is the first major vocation breakpoint. Finish the liberation arc, collect the Thief's Key pickups, review Lucky Panel for early equipment, then establish character-specific Beginner-to-Intermediate vocation routes. Vocations and later Moonlighting are separate unlocks.

documents.title: Vocation prerequisite graph
documents.locator: Vocation list and unlock requirements tables
documents.body: Intermediate prerequisites: Gladiator = Warrior + Martial Artist; Sage = Mage + Priest; Armamentalist = Warrior + Mage; Pirate = Thief + Sailor; Luminary = Dancer + Troubadour + Jester; Paladin = Martial Artist + Priest; Monster Wrangler = Thief + Shepherd. Advanced: Champion = Gladiator + Paladin; Druid = any two of Sage, Pirate, Luminary; Hero = any three of the seven Intermediate vocations.

documents.title: Completion-safe answer contract
documents.body: Before recommending advancement, check open missables, collectibles, fragments, monsters, shops, and one-time choices. Lead with STOP when content can be lost. Then list immediate completion actions, strongest legal setup, optional grind ceiling, and the safe advancement condition.

documents.title: Lucky Panel completion and power role
documents.body: Lucky Panel begins in the Alltrades region and can provide equipment earlier than shops. Several items are exclusive to its versions or chest pools, making it necessary for Heroic Hoarder. Preserve version, rank, chest status, and exclusivity for every normalized reward.

documents.title: Metal enemy farming progression
documents.body: Metal Slime: Roamer Encampment Region and Highendreigh Tower. Liquid Metal Slime: Heavy Metal Hole and The Beacon. Metal King Slime: La Bravoure Region and Hubble Region in the Present. Platinum King Jewel: Yet Another World. Metal enemies appear as additions to normal encounters rather than visible overworld targets.

documents.title: Mini Medal power thresholds
documents.locator: Mini Medal Rewards > All Mini Medal Rewards
documents.body: Notable rewards include Windcheater at 15, Magic Shield at 20, Liquid Metal Slime Heart at 45, Miracle Sword at 55, Metal King Slime Heart at 60, Sage's Stone at 65, Uber Gringham Whip at 90, Metal King Shield at 95, and Metal King Sword at 100.

documents.title: Early equipment optimization examples
documents.locator: Early game equipment recommendations by character
documents.body: Examples from Game8's early build layer include Cautery Sword and Magic Shield for Hero, Snooze Stick for Maribel before the Abbey seal is cleared because item-use effects remain available, and Windcheater for Ruff as an early defensive and drop-rate option. Treat these as checkpoint-scoped recommendations and verify exact acquisition before live advice.

documents.title: High-value Monster Heart roles
documents.locator: Best Monster Hearts ranking and effects
documents.body: Representative specialized effects include critical enhancement (Cyclops, Clawcerer), physical reflection (Cactiball), periodic nullification (Grody Gumdrops), early damage reduction (Zoma), guaranteed first turn (Dragster), and increased Metal encounter odds (Metal King Slime Heart). Ingest every effect and acquisition method before ranking globally.

documents.title: Fixed stat seeds and renewable farms
documents.locator: How to Farm Stat Seeds; All Stat Seeds Increase Rate
documents.body: Stat-seed gains are fixed in Reimagined. Game8 ranks Klepto Clobber as the strongest general seed-farming method, while rare-drop-only seeds require battle completion. The postgame Almighty loop awards a random Super Seed, and Hot Lucky Panel can yield Pretty Betsy with a three-prizes-per-in-game-day limit. Exact enemy acquisition rows still require normalization.
